antidotes.why: Hating no being, a friend to all.
Name the wrong only after it has been committed, never first for the wronged.
Who is left to quarrel with.

chains.summary: The pull of wanting and the push of aversion produce the delusion of the pairs, and all beings fall into confusion.
chains.title: The confusion of opposites

verses.m: Through the delusion of the pairs of opposites, arising from desire and aversion, Bharata, all beings fall into confusion at birth, scorcher of enemies.
verses.sa: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत । सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥

gloss: Dveṣa is the push away from what we dislike, twin of rāga. The Gita: both wait at every sense and are the waylayers (3.34).

heals.m: One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, even in pain and pleasure, and forgiving,
heals.sa: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
heals.why: Pictures a life with no hatred toward any being.

heals.m: "Holding no grudge and picking no quarrel, with neither craving nor fear, every direction is joyful to him. He starts nothing out of craving for results, clings to no house, wants no honour, is free of wrongdoing and anger, skilled and wise."
heals.sa: बैर न बिग्रह आस न त्रासा। सुखमय ताहि सदा सब आसा॥ अनारंभ अनिकेत अमानी। अनघ अरोष दच्छ बिग्यानी ॥
heals.why: Shows no grudge and no quarrel to maintain.

heals.m: One who sees all beings in the self, and the self in all beings, no longer shrinks away from anyone.
heals.sa: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्येवानुपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न विजुगुप्सते ॥
heals.why: Removes the other that revulsion needs.

heals.m: Liking and disliking belong to the mind, and you are never the mind. You are awareness itself, free of thought-forms and unchanging. Live happily.
heals.sa: रागद्वेषौ मनोधर्मौ न मनस्ते कदाचन । निर्विकल्पोऽसि बोधात्मा निर्विकारः सुखं चर ॥
heals.why: Heals aversion placed in the mind, not in the self.

heals.m: One who, by comparison with himself, sees the same everywhere, Arjuna, whether in pleasure or in pain, is considered the highest yogi.
heals.sa: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन । सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः ॥
heals.why: The other's pain is felt as one's own would be.

heals.m: Keep your mind on what is good and commit yourself to it. Do not become wicked in return for wickedness; always remain good.
heals.sa: यत्कल्याणमभिध्यायेत्तत्रात्मानं नियोजयेत् / न पापं प्रति पापः स्यात्साधुरेव सदा भवेत्
heals.why: Shows refusing to let another's wrong decide one's own character.

heals.m: Do not harm any living being; move through life with friendliness. Having been given this life, do not make an enemy of anyone.
heals.sa: न हिंस्यात्सर्वभूतानि मैत्रायणगतश्चरेत् / नेदं जीवितमासाद्यवैरं कुर्वीत केनचित्
heals.why: Weighs enmity against the worth of a life.

heals.m: To bear no ill will toward any being in deed, thought or word, to help, and to give: this is the timeless way of the good.
heals.sa: अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु कर्मणा मनसा गिरा / अनुग्रहश्च दानं च सतां धर्मः सनातनः
heals.why: Shows adroha, no ill will, set as the first mark of the good.

hero.m: One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, even in pain and pleasure, and forgiving,
hero.sa: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥

loci.m: One who hates no being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, even in pain and pleasure, and forgiving,
loci.sa: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥

loci.m: Attraction and aversion to sense objects lie seated in every sense. Do not come under their power; they are your enemies on the way.
loci.sa: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ । तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ ॥

loci.m: Through the delusion of the pairs of opposites, arising from desire and aversion, Bharata, all beings fall into confusion at birth, scorcher of enemies.
loci.sa: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत । सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥

practices.m: Friend mind, what is the use of so much chatter? Friend mind, all this is mere speculation. I have told you the heart of it: you are reality itself, vast as the sky.
practices.sa: सखे मनः किं बहुजल्पितेन सखे मनः सर्वमिदं वितर्क्यम् । यत्सारभूतं कथितं मया ते त्वमेव तत्त्वं गगनोपमोऽसि ॥

practices.m: Speech that causes no distress, that is truthful, pleasant and beneficial, and the regular study of sacred texts: this is called austerity of speech.
practices.sa: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् । स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
practices.why: Shows words chosen true, kind and helpful build goodwill.

practices.m: Contact of the senses with their objects brings cold and heat, pleasure and pain. They come and go and do not last. Bear them patiently, Arjuna.
One who, by comparison with himself, sees the same everywhere, Arjuna, whether in pleasure or in pain, is considered the highest yogi.
practices.sa: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन । सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः ॥
practices.why: Shows wishing others' happiness as one's own.

practices.m: Giving in secret, a warm welcome for whoever comes home, silence after doing a kindness, speaking in public of kindness received, no arrogance in wealth, talking of others without a whiff of contempt: who taught the good this vow, hard as walking a sword's edge?
practices.sa: प्रदानं प्रच्छन्नं गृहमुपगते सम्भ्रमविधिः प्रियं कृत्वा मौनं सदसि कथनं चाप्युपकृते । अनुत्सेको लक्ष्म्यामनभिभवगन्धाः परकथाः सतां केनोद्दिष्टं विषममसिधाराव्रतमिदम् ॥
practices.why: Shows no contempt in talk of others.

practices.m: Cut off craving, practise forbearance, give up arrogance, take no delight in wrong, speak the truth, follow the path of the good, serve the wise, honour those worthy of honour, win over even your enemies, show courtesy, guard your good name, be kind to those in pain: this is how the good behave.
practices.sa: तृष्णां छिन्धि भज क्षमां जहि मदं पापे रतिं मा कृथाः सत्यं ब्रूह्यनुयाहि साधुपदवीं सेवस्व विद्वज्जनम् । मान्यान् मानय विद्विषोऽप्यनुनय प्रख्यापय प्रश्रयं कीर्तिं पालय दुःखिते कुरु दयामेतत् सतां चेष्टितम् ॥

practices.m: Keep a grateful heart and a friendly spirit. Everything grows out of friendship; a friend is the greatest blessing.
practices.sa: कृतज्ञमनसा भाव्यं मित्रभावेन चानघ / मित्रात्प्रभवते सर्वं मित्रं धन्यतरं स्मृतम्
practices.why: Names friendship as the source of every good.

practices.m: Make a friend slowly, and give one up slowly. A friendship made slowly is one that lasts long.
practices.sa: चिरेण मित्रं बध्नीयाच्चिरेण च कृतं त्यजेत् / चिरेण हि कृतं मित्रं चिरं धारणमर्हति
practices.why: Shows slow friendship is the lasting kind.

stories.l: Respect those who teach you; and forgive like the teacher who prayed for his rude student.
stories.s: In an earlier life Kakbhushundi was a proud, wealthy, sharp-tongued young man whose gentle teacher kept trying to guide him. One day in the temple he refused even to rise when the teacher entered. The teacher said nothing, but a curse fell on the student; the teacher at once prayed for him, asking that he not be punished in anger. Lives later, the one thorn Kakbhushundi still carries is the memory of that teacher's gentleness.
stories.t: The student who would not stand for his teacher

stories.l: You can tell family the hard truth and still stand by them; humility does, boasting talks.
stories.s: Woken from months of sleep, Kumbhakarna tells Ravana bluntly that his pride caused this disaster and he acted in the wrong order. Then, loyal to his brother, he goes out to fight anyway, scorning boastful courtiers: the brave don't praise themselves, they act.

stories.l: Gratitude is the root of every friendship. Betraying a benefactor poisons everything after.
stories.s: A destitute brahmin, Gautama, is fed and sheltered by a kind crane, Rajadharma, and made rich by the crane's friend. On the way home he kills his sleeping benefactor for food. Bhishma ends: there is atonement for many wrongs, none for ingratitude.
